model.summary: allenai/OLMoE-1B-7B-0924 (olmoe, qwen2_moe): 16/16 MoE layers, E=64 H=2048 I=1024, top-8; 6.44B expert + 0.48B dense params

performance.statement: not predicted: no performance model is calibrated for this backend yet; the ordering below rests on measured relative speeds, not on a time estimate

reasons: experts4bit: kernel paged_graphs not usable here: the fused FP8 KV append casts to e4m3 in Triton, which needs sm_89+; this device is sm_86
experts4bit: vram_gb sized to 0.899, the largest the device budget allows
experts4bit: dram_gb sized to 1.390, the largest the host budget allows

experts split across tiers (placement solver): 0.90 GiB in VRAM, 1.39 GiB in DRAM (computed on the CPU), 1.09 GiB on NVMe (streamed through the cold tier); all-VRAM needs 4.76 GiB + headroom, over the 3.00 GiB budget

tier budgets: VRAM filled to the device budget, then DRAM to the host budget less its headroom (E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB / E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB); routing is assumed uniform, as serve_paged runs the solver without a profile
kernels: grouped-nf4-gemm's native CPU kernels (the solver's DRAM tier computes on the CPU)
KV pool 0.03 GiB for 1 sequences x 512 tokens; it scales linearly in both

kernels: paged FP8 KV pool + attention, f32 compute (fp8 compute needs sm_89+, fp8_paged_attn.fp8_compute_unsupported); grouped NF4 / int4 decode routes as serve_paged resolves them (reported at /health)
ordering, graphs: decode graphs before eager decode: serve_paged's own default for all-VRAM placement on CUDA (_graphs_env); the graph pools are listed as not modelled

first-chunk prefill graph off (the server's default is auto): its private pool is not priced (SC2b measured +3.3 GiB at Qwen3-30B), so the plan's memory would not bound the process; fix prefill_graph=auto to let the server engage it when that much is free
not planned yet: a measured routing profile for the solver, int4 expert stores, decode speed

to serve it: E4B_PAGED_BUCKETS=1,2,4,8,16 E4B_PAGED_CHUNK_TOKENS=512 E4B_PAGED_DRAM_GB=1.39 E4B_PAGED_GRAPHS=0 E4B_PAGED_HOT_ROWS=64 E4B_PAGED_KV_GROUPS=auto E4B_PAGED_MAX_SEQS=1 E4B_PAGED_MAX_TOKENS_PER_SEQ=512 E4B_PAGED_PLACEMENT=solver E4B_PAGED_PREFILL_GRAPH=0 E4B_PAGED_VRAM_GB=0.899 python -m experts4bit_qlora.serve_paged (with the model's arena and calibration)
